correctness.rationale: In the free class-two model L=V+Lambda^2 V, the center is exactly Lambda^2 V for r>=2. For noncentral vertices v+z and w+z prime, the bracket is v wedge w, which vanishes exactly when v and w are linearly dependent. Therefore projective quotient directions are precisely the commuting classes, each with q^(r choose 2)(q-1) central lifts. This proves the complete multipartite graph. The independence, clique, chromatic, degree, spectrum, and automorphism formulas are standard exact consequences of that graph, and the equality cases classify maximum independent sets and optimal colorings. The packaged checker reconstructs the relation from explicit wedge coordinates in five examples.

value.rationale: The free two-step nilpotent Lie algebra is the universal object for class-two nilpotent Lie algebras with fixed generator rank, so it is a canonical test family rather than an arbitrary slice. The theorem determines the entire noncommuting graph and all basic extremal data in closed form and identifies maximum commuting sets with projective directions/maximal abelian subalgebras. This gives a clean benchmark for how graph structure changes under quotients of the universal class-two algebra.
